title: Part 2: Uvogin Finally Meets His Match

cuts.voiceover_text: The chains are not just holding Uvogin; they are draining the confidence out of him. Kurapika’s captured opponent strains against the links wrapped across his chest, legs, and arms. Nothing gives. Uvogin sweats, bares his teeth, and tries to force his way free, but the chain stays locked. Kurapika watches with his scarlet eyes wide and unblinking. He explains the terrifying part: Uvogin’s aura is not breaking the weapon because the chain has already shut that power down. The screen turns into a violent burst of white energy and branching lightning. Uvogin is still standing, but his certainty is gone. He stares at Kurapika, trapped inside a rule he cannot overpower. Kurapika is not calming him down. He is making the danger impossible to ignore.

Uvogin still attacks. He closes the distance as Kurapika slips around him, and the chain snaps tight across the giant’s body again. Kurapika’s scarlet eyes stay fixed on him. Uvogin is suddenly the one reacting. His face twists from rage into panic, sweat running down his brow as he realizes the condition behind the chain. This weapon is not meant for an ordinary opponent. It is built for the Phantom Troupe. Kurapika can use it because Uvogin is one of them. The chain drags Uvogin back, and his confidence collapses into blood and desperation. Kurapika raises one hand and the aura around it flickers. Uvogin is already wounded, but he keeps resisting. Then Kurapika extends the chain between them and holds him at the end of it. The distance looks safe. It is not. Kurapika steps forward with the chain drawn tight, while Uvogin can only glare through the links. He has learned the rule. He still does not know what Kurapika plans to do with it.

series.summary: Kurapika’s chains expose the limit of Uvogin’s power, then the fight turns toward a deadly reveal.
